profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Taxwire
profile.summary:
Growing up, I always had an immense interest in the way that computers worked. In my first experiences with software development, a simple "Hello, World" application, my appetite for programming was born. That ever-growing passion (and a sprinkle of dedication) drove me to pursue a career in the field, but the education didn't stop there. Now, with the title of Software Engineer bestowed upon me by Kennesaw State University, I continue to grow and learn in my free time to further my familiarity with the most innovative and ground-breaking technologies that are available. The persistent learning that I strive for makes every new technology I encounter and every new line of code I write feel like that very first "Hello World."

Languages: Python, Typescript, Javascript, SQL

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Peachtree Corners, Georgia, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Full-stack engineer across multiple squads, with a track record of taking on new domains quickly and delivering end-to-end.
• Served as T3 escalation engineer, using Datadog, Fullstory, and OpenSearch to diagnose and resolve complex platform bugs across the full stack
• Built and shipped an internal admin tool for provisioning and managing instances and users via Auth0 APIs
• Contributed to the SaaSOptics/Chargify integration as part of the platform merger, delivering UI updates, new API endpoints, and backend features in Django
• Currently building a full-stack CPQ/quoting tool (Python, Flask, TypeScript) that allows users to create, edit, and sign PDFs which flow back into the core Maxio billing platform
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Python · JavaScript · Django · Flask · React.js

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer III
positions.description:
Senior engineer leading architecture, delivery, and team development across a microservices platform.
Designed and launched a Python-based internal authorization service on AWS (Auth0, ALB, DynamoDB, Lambda) securing access for 600+ users
• Built a React/TypeScript access control UI managing 4,000+ permissions across multiple microservices
• Designed a Kafka Confluent pub/sub event system on Node.js distributed across AWS Lambdas, enabling internal and external service subscriptions
• Reduced engineer onboarding time by 50% through structured documentation and hands-on mentorship of junior engineers
positions.insights: Skills: Git · React.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · Python · Node.js · TypeScript

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-stack contractor building internal tooling and vendor-facing applications at enterprise scale.
• Enhanced a vendor-facing web application used by 10,000+ suppliers using Python, React, Kubernetes, and Docker
• Led a front-end redesign migrating from Material UI to Ant Design, improving user engagement and aligning the app with company brand standards
• Built and maintained SQL pipelines via Jenkins delivering sales metrics on 1M+ products across 2,300 stores, used for internal and external vendor reporting
• Automated manual processes and implemented CI/CD pipelines, freeing up 200+ hours per year for the EDW team
• Used an in-house ML anomaly detection tool to identify and resolve data errors, achieving a 95% reduction in data issues
positions.insights: Skills: Git · React.js · Python · SQL · JavaScript · Machine Learning · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Data Migration Consultant
positions.description:
Helped SaaS companies migrate historical financial data into SaaSOptics and get maximum value from the platform.
• Led 20+ client data migrations using Python, reducing average migration time by 200%
• Provided analytics support and reporting guidance to 50+ clients, delivering actionable recommendations to improve billing and revenue recognition workflows
• Collaborated directly with C-level executives to streamline SaaS operations and drive cost efficiencies
positions.insights: Skills: Git · Data Migration · Python · Microsoft Excel · Data Analysis

positions.title: Data Specialist, Google @ Premium
positions.description:
Supported the launch of Google's Made by Google product line, including Pixel 2 and Google Home Mini/Max.
• Led automated data collection efforts using public APIs and web scraping to enable efficient, accurate data acquisition
• Cleaned and restructured legacy database systems using Microsoft SQL Server and Vizio, improving data accuracy and operational reliability
positions.insights: Skills: Python · SQL · Data Analysis · Web Scraping · JavaScript

positions.title: Installation Technician
positions.description:
Contracted to Cobb County School District and Atlanta Public Schools to deploy and maintain classroom technology.
• Installed and configured computers, projectors, and interactive flat panels across school facilities
• Coordinated with school staff and technology vendors to ensure installations were completed on time and within budget
• Troubleshot technical issues on-site, keeping students and teachers equipped with functioning tools

volunteerExperiences.description: Assisting with Paulding County Sheriff's Office to provide underprivileged children in the community with the opportunity to shop for daily essentials and toys to bring cheer to their holiday season.
